forbidden.name: utils-imports-nothing
forbidden.comment: utils is the bottom layer: generic helpers only.

forbidden.name: sources-do-not-import-each-other
forbidden.comment: A source file may import sources/shared.ts and sources/types.ts, never another source. registry.ts is the one file that lists them all.

forbidden.name: only-cli-imports-the-composition-root
forbidden.comment: cli.ts and migrate.ts compose the modules; nothing below them may reach back up.

forbidden.name: only-cli-imports-admin
forbidden.comment: The admin console is wired in by cli.ts alone; no other module may depend on it.

forbidden.name: admin-never-imports-web
forbidden.comment: Admin may query the listable_event view in SQL but must not share web code.

forbidden.name: admin-reads-ingestion-registry-only
forbidden.comment: From ingestion the admin takes the source list and the run-window constant, nothing that writes.

forbidden.name: admin-ui-is-browser-only
forbidden.comment: The frontend runs in the browser: it may use utils helpers and the API types, never server modules.

forbidden.name: web-ui-is-a-leaf
forbidden.comment: src/web/ui is the shadcn component folder: it imports utils (and itself) only, so any page can use it and it can never reach into a route.
